attchmntText: United Drilling Tools Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Financial Results'.
voiceSummary: United Drilling Tools Limited board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Net profit for the quarter was 168.25 lakhs. Net profit for the half year was 583.24 lakhs. The board also approved material related party transactions with wholly owned subsidiary P Mittal Manufacturing Pvt Ltd. The company issued a corporate guarantee in favor of the subsidiary. A postal ballot notice will be issued to obtain shareholder approval for these transactions. The statutory auditors issued a limited review report stating no material misstatements were found. Revenue from operations for the quarter was 1,623.86 lakhs. Total assets as of September 30, 2026, stood at 31,478.37 lakhs.
